options.content: Host and workload metrics run on the VPS; Argo CD and monitoring run on OpenShift. The namespace selector filters workload panels only. **Tailscale:** proxy metrics are enabled by the default ProxyClass, but service proxies need explicit scrape wiring before their metrics can appear here. Missing telemetry is shown as unavailable, never a synthetic healthy zero.
